name: security-audit
description: Security-audit skill that turns the agent into a security auditor — a six-phase pipeline (recon → hunt → validate → report → structured output → independent verification) using parallel sub-agents to find exploitable vulnerabilities with real impact, not checklist deviations. Vendored from cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT). Complements code-audit-rigor: this one actively hunts exploits; code-audit-rigor governs PR/branch review with quantitative decision frameworks.
